stories.title: Landtag von Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD stellt Präsident und Vize – SPD-Kandidat verfehlt Mehrheit klar

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt Parliament: AfD appoints president and vice president – SPD candidate clearly misses majority
en.summary: The state parliament will be led by two politicians from a far-right party and one from the CDU. The SPD's candidate for president failed to secure sufficient votes.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD stellt Landtagspräsidenten - Brandmauer bröckelig?

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: AfD appoints state parliament president - firewall crumbling?
en.summary: The AfD has secured the position of state parliament president in Saxony-Anhalt.

stories.title: Liveblog Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD stellt mit Tillschneider auch einen Vizepräsidenten - SPD-Kandidat fällt durch

en.title: Live Blog Saxony-Anhalt: AfD also appoints Tillschneider as vice president - SPD candidate fails
en.summary: Hans-Thomas Tillschneider was elected AfD vice president with more votes than his party holds, despite other factions including BSW declaring they would not support an AfD candidate.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Magdeburger Landtag: SPD-Kandidat fällt bei Vize-Wahl durch

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Magdeburg Parliament: SPD candidate fails in vice president election
en.summary: The SPD candidate for vice president in the Saxony-Anhalt state parliament did not receive enough votes to be elected.

stories.title: Wahl Sachsen-Anhalt im Liveticker: CDU stellt zweiten Landtags-Vizepräsidenten

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt Election in Live Ticker: CDU Appoints Second Landtag Vice President
en.summary: Carsten Borchert from the CDU parliamentary group was elected as the second vice president of the Saxony-Anhalt state parliament, receiving 64 yes votes out of 82 cast votes.

stories.title: News des Tages: Landtag in Sachsen-Anhalt, August Hanning festgenommen, Moskau meldet ukrainischen Drohnenangriff

en.title: News of the Day: Landtag in Saxony-Anhalt, August Hanning Arrested, Moscow Reports Ukrainian Drone Attack
en.summary: Saxony-Anhalt became the first German state parliament to elect a far-right president. Former BND chief August Hanning was arrested on suspicion of attempted treason. Ukraine continues military operations against Russia.

stories.title: Fusion von Paramount und Warner Bros.: Der neue Gigant in Hollywood könnte auf tönernen Füßen stehen

en.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Merger: The New Hollywood Giant Could Be Standing on Shaky Ground
en.summary: Paramount and Warner Bros. are merging to create a major studio combination. The merger raises questions about the changes it will bring to Hollywood and implications for media independence in the United States.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt - Magdeburg: Tobias Rausch ist AfD-Landtagspräsident, Carsten Borchert und Hans-Thomas Tillschneider werden Vize

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt - Magdeburg: Tobias Rausch is AfD State Parliament President, Carsten Borchert and Hans-Thomas Tillschneider are Vice Presidents
en.summary: AfD politician Tobias Rausch was elected president of the Saxony-Anhalt state parliament with two vice presidents: party colleague Hans-Thomas Tillschneider and CDU politician Carsten Borchert. SPD candidate Armin Willingmann was not elected.

stories.title: Paramount übernimmt Warner offiziell - große Fusion in Hollywood

en.title: Paramount officially acquires Warner - major Hollywood merger
en.summary: Paramount has finalized its multibillion-dollar acquisition of the Warner conglomerate after months of negotiations. The merger raises concerns about job losses in Hollywood and potential political influence.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD stellt mit Tillschneider auch Landtagsvizepräsident

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: AfD appoints Tillschneider as parliament vice president
en.summary: AfD politician Tillschneider has been elected as vice president of the new parliament in Saxony-Anhalt. Tillschneider has represented the AfD in the state parliament since 2016.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: AfD stellt zum ersten Mal Landtagspräsidenten

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: AfD appoints parliament president for the first time
en.summary: Tobias Rausch received more votes than expected in his election as parliament president in Saxony-Anhalt, securing support beyond his own party and the BSW.

stories.title: Paramount and Warner Bros merge into one Hollywood giant

en.title: Paramount and Warner Bros merge into one Hollywood giant
en.summary: Paramount has completed an 81 billion dollar acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a major entertainment company under billionaire David Ellison's ownership after defeating competing bids.

stories.title: China: Bundesregierung soll Taiwan-Krieg durchspielen – China-Kommission fordert Stresstest für Wirtschaft

en.title: China: German government should conduct Taiwan war scenario – China Commission demands economic stress test
en.summary: A parliamentary commission is proposing tougher measures toward China and recommends the government conduct stress tests on the economy in response to potential Taiwan conflict scenarios. The government is already working on similar measures.

stories.title: Märkte Insight: Die Ausgangslage für den Dax ist fast zu schön, um wahr zu sein

en.title: Markets Insight: The starting position for the DAX is almost too good to be true
en.summary: Seasonal factors suggest significant increases in German stock market prices. However, there is a catch that complicates this outlook.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Deutliche Mehrheit für Tobias Rausch: Landtag wählt erstmals AfD-Kandidaten zum Präsidenten

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Clear majority for Tobias Rausch: State parliament elects AfD candidate as president for the first time
en.summary: Tobias Rausch was elected parliamentary president with votes from across the chamber's political spectrum. The AfD secured the position alongside the CDU gaining a vice presidency, while the SPD candidate did not succeed.

stories.title: Molkerei: Theo Müller schließt zwei ostdeutsche Werke – über 300 Mitarbeiter betroffen

en.title: Dairy: Theo Müller closes two East German plants – over 300 employees affected
en.summary: A dairy company is shutting down two facilities in eastern Germany following restructuring efforts that failed to achieve profitability. Approximately 160 workers at each site face potential job losses.

stories.title: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning: Das ist der Mann, der Staatsgeheimnisse verraten haben soll

en.title: Ex-BND Chief Hanning: The Man Accused of Betraying State Secrets
en.summary: Federal prosecutors have charged former BND president August Hanning with espionage and attempted treason. The case involves allegations related to the disclosure of classified information.
